raw_segments.text: a fever with the absence of her son, a madness of which her life's in danger.
Heavens, how deeply you at once do touch me.
Imogen, the great part of my comfort, gone, my queen upon a desperate bed, and
in a time when fearful wars point at me, her son gone, so needful for this present.
It strikes me past the hope of comfort.
But for thee, fellow, who needs must know of her departure and
thus seem so ignorant, will enforce it from thee by a sharp torture.
